calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-23-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Three Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Diana Padilla.
Petitioner: Stephen G. Ujlaki, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Chiava Benedetta Lucia Ujlaki; George Filippo Formenti-Ujlaki and Philip Nicolas Formenti-Ujlaki, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Chiara Benedetta Lucia Formenti-Ujlaki de Stael von Holstein; George Filippo Formenti-Ujlaki de Stael von Holstein and Philip Nicolas Formenti-Ujlaki de Stael von Holstein.
Decree signed in open court.
